items.title: The Green Hole in Tokyo
items.task: Why does one of the world’s biggest cities keep this huge green hole in its middle?

choices.response: People did build here. Look older.

choices.text: It is tied to the palace and old Edo Castle
choices.response: Yes. The castle grounds became this green.
Tokyo builds on harder sites than this.
The empty centre is much older than a new park.

items.followUp: Find one defensive feature: moat, wall or gate.
